cohort: A (Narthex — outer arches, near-black fields, ember accents)
description: Cohort A covers the induction arc (Doses I–III): the reader at the threshold (p1c1), the forced Loyalist/Whig verdict (p1c2), and the three secret case studies (p1c3). Narthex grammar per ART-DIRECTION.md §6: darkest plates, candle small and distant, light growing strictly I→III. Supervisor merges sequentially into design/chapters.json per READER-CONTRACT §4.

p1c1.caption: Dose I · The narthex door
p1c1.content_rationale: Ch.1 ends with the reader still outside the argument: eleven doses are promised but none yet swallowed, and the closing movement demands a 'reassessment' the reader has not performed. The plate stages that threshold literally — one portal ajar in near-black, one candle small and distant, one lit dose-notch of eleven. The parapet oculus carries a single Sanctuary ember: the sodium core translated into the book's only sanctioned red.
p1c1.opener_composition: #chapter-art.arch plate (~320px desktop, ≥200px phones) → 'DOSE I · PART I' Marcellus numeral line → Marcellus title → candle rule (Ashen line, flame pip) → calm body. Darkest plate in the book; no art behind prose.
p1c1.palette_role: GI2 narthex floor: Narthex ground, Ashlar stone, single Sanctuary ember mass + one Candle flame + three spill wedges. All other light withheld.
p1c1.reading_treatment: Quiet Source Serif 4 body (≤68ch); Marcellus Candle drop cap on the opening address; end seal ≤32px arch-door in Dose I ember tint (#A83A2C).
p1c1.title: The Red Pill

p1c2.caption: Dose II · Two arches
p1c2.content_rationale: Ch.2's procedure is a forced binary choice with no third side — the Whig antihistory the reader arrived with versus the Loyalist history of Hutchinson, Oliver, and Stedman. Two identical intact portals: the received one shut and dark, the examined one ajar and lit. Both histories stand; only the reader moves. Lit/unlit diamonds mark before/after with zero GI1-violating breakage.
p1c2.opener_composition: #chapter-art.arch plate centered full-slot-width so the bilateral shut/lit contrast reads instantly → 'DOSE II · PART I' meta stack per §5 → calm body. Symmetric verdict composition, not a journey.
p1c2.palette_role: Second-darkest: Sanctuary ember confined to the right leaf + mullion diamond; one Candle flame + lit diamond + right-side spill wedges. Left half starved of warm hues (Ashen/greystone only).
p1c2.reading_treatment: Quiet body; Marcellus Candle drop cap on the mid-treatment opening ('We have swallowed the red pill'); long 18th-century primary quotations stay in calm measure; end seal ≤32px twin-arch in Dose II tint (#AC432B).
p1c2.title: The American Rebellion

p1c3.caption: Dose III · Three lancets
p1c3.content_rationale: Ch.3 is a triptych by construction — AGW, KFM, HNU, each a democratic feedback loop between public misperception and official malpractice, each closed with its own off-the-map prescription. Three tall lancets give each case its own window: full ember (AGW), full candle (KFM), half-lit with glass intact (HNU, the hardest dose). The i/ii/iii numerals are the chapter's own counting made architectural. NOTE: book-identity.json labels this entry class 'lancets'; treated as arch-family slot treatment per ART-DIRECTION §6 Cohort A rule — supervisor resolves at merge.
p1c3.opener_composition: #chapter-art.arch plate → 'DOSE III · PART I' meta stack → calm body. Brightest Narthex plate: the wall itself warms as the nave approaches. Motif id three-lancets sets body[data-art] for motif-scoped CSS.
p1c3.palette_role: Brightest Narthex plate: wall mid-tone lifted vs. the door plates; Sanctuary Red owns lancet 1 + lancet 3 lower lights, Candle owns lancet 2; flame-gradient feet under all three. Ember→gold logic inside the two sanctioned warm hues.
p1c3.reading_treatment: Quiet body with strict measure discipline (14.5k words, longest in cohort; no mid-chapter insertions); Marcellus Candle drop cap on the Loyalist-now opening; end seal ≤32px three-lancet in Dose III tint (#B14D2A).
p1c3.title: AGW, KFM, and HNU
